title: Terms of the Downside Protection Sold with a Refined Fuels Pre-Buy Booking
content:
Downside protection is sold with a pre-buy booking on the programmes under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts that carry it, at the programme's fee per gallon charged when the booking is taken, and it cannot be added to a booking afterwards.

**It works one way only.**

**When a credit arises.** The clause formerly stated here — "Where the posted price for the product falls below the programme's floor percentage of the price the gallons were booked at, the member is credited the difference between the floor and the posted price on the gallons still undrawn, measured on the last trading day of the month." — is carried for the record and is no longer in force as the basis on which the protected floor is arrived at. The measurement day under this basis remains the last trading day of the month.

**When nothing arises.** Where the posted price stays at or above the floor nothing is credited and the fee is not returned.

**What the credit attaches to and what it does not change.** The credit attaches to the booking it was sold with and is applied to the account rather than paid out, and it does not change the price the remaining gallons draw at, which is still the booked price.

**When protection ends.** Protection ends when the booking is exhausted, when the gallons expire, or when the booking is cancelled, and no credit is worked out after that.

**What is not sold.** A member asking for protection against the price rising has misunderstood the product, and nothing in the catalogue offers it.

## The terms, restated as conditions

| Condition | Consequence under these terms |
| --- | --- |
| The protection was not bought at the time the booking was taken | It cannot be added afterwards |
| The posted price stands at or above the floor | Nothing is credited, and the fee is not returned |
| A credit falls due | It attaches to the booking it was sold with, and is applied to the account rather than paid out |
| The booking is exhausted, the gallons expire, or the booking is cancelled | The protection ends, and no credit is worked out after that |
| The member wants cover against a rising price | Nothing in the catalogue offers it |
